verdict.rationale: Fireflies advertises 'AskFred: AI assistant' as a paid feature and an AI bot (fred@fireflies.ai) that can be invited to meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize, which is a built-in assistant a user can delegate meeting-related tasks to. However, evidence never details what tasks AskFred can perform beyond note-taking/summarization, provides no hands-on walkthrough, and gives no independent corroboration of its task-delegation capabilities. Missing for 10: detailed docs on AskFred's task scope/commands, hands-on or independent verification of delegating tasks to it, and clarity on limits beyond meeting summarization.
